correctness.rationale: Petersen is KG(5,2). Any independent set of size 4 is a unique complete star; a 3-colouring of 10 vertices must have such a 4-class, and the leftover six vertices induce 3K2, whose 3+3 classes are a three-star (centre t≠c) and the complementary triangle. This yields exactly 5×4×3!=120 named states (c,t;A,B,C), with no missing assignments. Analyzing each pair of colour classes: BC has three isolated two-vertex components (3 moves), AB has a singleton and a connected six-cycle (2 moves), AC connected (1 move), giving six exact neighbor transformations and quotient adjacency. Independent enumeration over all 3^10=59049 color assignments reconstructed the legal Kempe components directly; it found 120 states, 360 edges, all six-regular, shortest-path shells (1,6,25,61,27), radius/diameter 4, and 60 one-site-recoloring edges. The transitive action of permutations of 5 ground labels and named colours transfers the representative distance census to all states. Entire finite case is exhaustively classified rather than extrapolated to all cubic graphs.
